title: Run the harness Claude CLI worker under governed permissions
goal: A cli:claude harness turn can run under the Claude CLI's own restricted mode (file tools confined to the worktree, cargo the only program allowed by name, no settings, hooks, CLAUDE.md or MCP servers, prompts denied) instead of --dangerously-skip-permissions, selected by the presence of SUSI_HARNESS_CLI_GOVERNED; a tool with no governed profile and a command override are refused before launch; without the variable the invocation is unchanged.

reuse.searched: Inside Susi: crates/susi-harness adaptive.rs/monthly.rs/workload.rs (the Argon-only presence opt-in and the workload Codex sandbox route are the existing policy patterns), executor.rs and the adapter's native six-tool worker contract. Outside: the installed Claude Code CLI's own switches (claude --help: --restricted, --safe-mode, --strict-mcp-config, --tools, --permission-mode, --permission-prompts, --allowedTools).
reuse.reason: Reuse the CLI's own restricted mode and the crate's existing presence-opt-in pattern; no sandbox is built and no dependency is added.

results.change: SUSI_HARNESS_CLI_GOVERNED (presence opt-in) makes CliSubRunner run Claude Code in its own restricted mode on the cli:, sub: and monthly: routes; any other tool and any command override are refused before launch; without the variable every invocation is unchanged. executor::run and AdaptiveRunner::from_env read it through CliSubRunner::from_env.
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib adaptive passed (the governed checks are adaptive::monthly::tests::governed_policy_swaps_claudes_bypass_and_refuses_the_rest).
results.live: Four harness missions ran a cli:claude:sonnet worker under this profile on Linux x86_64; in a probe the profile allowed an edit inside the workspace and cargo, and denied curl, git init, a read of /etc/hostname and a write outside the workspace.
results.coordination: This cloud session could read the Susi Board but every push of refs/board/* and refs/claims/* was refused with HTTP 403, so no claim was published and the task could not be closed through the queue (close needs a live claim). Mandate 76 section 7.3: coordinated through this record and the commit trailers.
